source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 4 June 1955, p. 8 ("Local government elections: Belfast rural results"); Irish News, 2 June 1955, p. 5; Ballymena Observer, 10 June 1955, p. 9 ("Notice of Result of Elections: Rural District of Ballymena, 1955")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)

note: Triennial election of the rural district council, polled Thursday 2 June 1955 in two divisions (Dunminning and Kells). All 23 divisions are taken from the returning officer's notice of result (Form No. 23; Ballymena Observer, 10 June 1955, p. 9): candidates, votes where a poll was taken, persons elected and retiring members deemed re-elected (Cromkill, Glenravel, Lisnagarron and Longmore). No party labels are printed; places of abode are not reproduced. The notice spells two divisions Glenraville and Glenwhirry; the usual spellings are used here. Loughridge, outgoing member; Strange.
